long_biography.plain_text:
At an ACICO Industries annual meeting, Abdulaziz Ahmad Abdullah Al Ayyoub told shareholders that diversification, product quality and tighter governance would support regional growth. His role there followed a telecommunications career: he earned an electrical-engineering degree from the University of New Mexico and later served as chief executive of Zain.

Al Ayyoub was elected to the ACICO board as chairman in May 2016. At ACICO, he led the board's oversight of corporate governance and strategy across the company's industrial, contracting and property divisions. Market records place the end of the chairmanship in March 2019. The current ACICO board identifies another chairman.
